crossRefs.note: Praise Yah! Praise Yahweh from the heavens! Praise him in the heights!
You divided the sea by your strength. You broke the heads of the sea monsters in the waters.
You broke the heads of Leviathan in pieces. You gave him as food to people and desert creatures.
There is the sea, great and wide, in which are innumerable living things, both small and large animals.
There the ships go, and leviathan, whom you formed to play there.
God created the large sea creatures and every living creature that moves, with which the waters swarmed, after their…
“Can you draw out Leviathan with a fish hook, or press down his tongue with a cord?
In that day, Yahweh with his hard and great and strong sword will punish leviathan, the fleeing serpent, and leviathan…
The animals of the field, the jackals and the ostriches, shall honor me, because I give water in the wilderness and…
Awake, awake, put on strength, arm of Yahweh! Awake, as in the days of old, the generations of ancient times. Isn’t it…
Isn’t it you who dried up the sea, the waters of the great deep; who made the depths of the sea a way for the redeemed…

translations.web: Praise Yahweh from the earth, you great sea creatures, and all depths;
translations.bsb: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
translations.kjv: Praise the LORD from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:
translations.asv: Praise Jehovah from the earth, Ye sea-monsters, and all deeps.
